concerns.analysis: The source PDF contains several meaningful images that are missing from the HTML output. For instance, on page 2, there is a screenshot of a mobile 'Success' dialog box associated with step 9. The HTML output provides the text for step 9 but omits the accompanying image.
concerns.source_pdf_quote: Page 2 of the PDF contains a screenshot of a "Success" dialog box on a mobile device under step 9.
concerns.output_quote: The HTML lists step 9 as text ("Acknowledge the success message on your phone by clicking “Ok”.") but does not contain the corresponding image of the success dialog.

concerns.analysis: The source document features multiple continuous numbered lists that span across interspersed images. In the output JSON, these lists are incorrectly fractured into multiple independent ordered lists, which will cause the numbering to reset to 1 repeatedly when rendered in HTML. For example, on page 2, steps 1 through 9 of the Authenticator enrollment process are broken into six separate ordered lists. Similarly, on page 4, steps 1 through 5 for 'For an existing MFA method' are split into three
concerns.source_pdf_quote: 1. Download the Simeio... 2.Login to https://myncid.nc.gov/ in your computer... 5. Select “Authenticator” and click:
concerns.output_quote: Multiple separate {"type": "list", "list_type": "ordered"} objects, including an isolated ordered list containing only: [{"text": "Select “Authenticator” and click:"}]

concerns.analysis: The HTML output embeds full-page images of the slides alongside the extracted text. The first image in the HTML corresponds to a full-page rendering of the first slide, and it is immediately followed by the extracted text from that same slide, causing the user to see the content twice.
